denominators.panel_c: Studies with resolved primary citation-use classifications: scVI 951, scGPT 402, scGen 214 and GEARS 84.
denominators.panel_d: Classification-validation studies with resolved LLM labels: scVI 39 and scGPT, scGen and GEARS 40 each.

reporting_notes: Panel C shows mutually exclusive primary categories rather than non-exclusive use labels.
Panel C uses logarithmic color normalization from the smallest positive displayed fraction to the maximum; zero is shown with a neutral near-white fill.
Panel D omits macro averages and reports category-level precision and recall.
Both precision and recall are N/A when a method-category pair has zero positive human-reference labels.
Human consensus is a sampled reference standard; validation values are point estimates without confidence intervals.
